newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber higher in noon trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber higher in noon trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were higher at midday on Monday in sluggish trading, traders said.

They said buyers bid at 48.625 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan for August shipment, but no deals were done. Offer prices were also quoted at 48.50 fob Surabaya and Medan, 48.25 fob Jambi and at 48.00 fob Pontianak.
"Offer prices are higher but we don't hear any deals today," said one trader.

Traders said they largely ignored the fact that trade was shifting its attention to Malaysian rubber and away from Thai rubber as the high support in Bangkok gave Malaysian-origins a discount in the market.
"I don't think that is an issue here. We just don't care to which country the buyers come from. What we care is they come to us," said another trader.
